title: chore: sync OpenRouter key to staging and dev
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces only `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in Gen's encrypted staging and dev files with the verified production value, following explicit scoped approval.
- Keeps production and every other decrypted secret unchanged; keeps this rotation separate from the Perplexity fallback changes.
- Validates the production credential with seven successful Sonar requests covering all three models, streaming, terminal usage, and low/high search tiers.
- Verifies the decrypted diffs contain only the approved key; Biome and `git diff --check` pass. Staging synchronization and local dev verification follow this merge.

gist.headline: The staging hive gets nectar
gist.blurb: Gen's staging and dev hives now carry the same verified OpenRouter access as production. A small key rotation, carefully kept inside its own flowerbed.
gist.summary: Synchronized Gen's encrypted staging and development OPENROUTER_API_KEY configuration with the verified production credential while leaving production and all other secrets unchanged.
gist.impact: Non-production Gen environments gain consistent OpenRouter model access for development and staging verification, including streaming and search-tier workflows.
gist.visual_concept: A carefully labeled staging-and-dev garden shed represents non-production environments receiving a single approved API key from a secure production hive. Polli, wearing a tiny locksmith apron, tends two code-plants beside a retro terminal while ensuring the larger production flower remains untouched.
